scope: Representative Aizome + Tatami installed configuration evaluated on wx-workstation; not a recording of the affected machine. Sources warm; single-run comparisons; no host activation.

snapshot_comparison.limitation: Unchanged repeat evaluation only. New inputs/configuration still require evaluation; cold source download was not timed.

source_archive.storage: Immutable Git history; not Git archive export-ignore. Sizes are uncompressed tracked blob bytes, not network transfer.

decisions: Use immutable directory snapshots and persistent derivation cache; retain original references for Git metadata and local path inputs.
Instantiate once, plan substitutions and build by derivation; log phase times.
Default Sekka to 8 evaluator threads with an override; standalone Yukimi preserves Nix settings.
Preserve distinct package-set pins: the exploratory AI/OMP consolidation changed package identities, with only small single-run timing gains.
Preserve the existing main binary-cache publication workflow; early updates may arrive before cache publication completes.

packaged_helper.scope: Nix-built helper workspace tests; ignored test contacts GitHub.

rootless_transactions.scope: Real helper and CLI with Nix/systemd stubs. Includes phase order/timings, missing lock, rollback on snapshot/evaluation failure, cancellation, and GC root cleanup.

real_nix_vm.scope: Cached fixture system, packaged helper and real Determinate Nix in a disposable VM. Trace present on first evaluation, absent on unchanged retry, present after source edit; same output; roots removed after all three operations. No existing host profile or service changed.

limits: The VM check covers cached outputs, not guest compilation, an ISO or hardware qualification.
An exploratory in-guest compilation fixture returned builder SIGKILL in direct Nix as well as through the helper; it was not used to claim compilation coverage.
The original affected machine and its multi-minute stall were not observed.
